package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
)

// These tests are opt-in because they exercise a real disposable PostgreSQL
// database. The database name must end in _test so a developer cannot point
// them at the live review database by accident.
func teacherDecisionIntegrationPool(t *testing.T) *pgxpool.Pool {
	t.Helper()
	databaseURL := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("TEACHER_TEST_DATABASE_URL"))
	if databaseURL == "" {
		t.Skip("TEACHER_TEST_DATABASE_URL is not configured")
	}
	config, err := pgxpool.ParseConfig(databaseURL)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, strings.HasSuffix(config.ConnConfig.Database, "_test"), "TEACHER_TEST_DATABASE_URL must target a database ending in _test")
	pool, err := NewPool(context.Background(), databaseURL)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	t.Cleanup(pool.Close)
	return pool
}

type teacherDecisionIntegrationFixture struct {
	pool      *pgxpool.Pool
	teacherID string
	studentID string
}

func newTeacherDecisionIntegrationFixture(t *testing.T) *teacherDecisionIntegrationFixture {
	t.Helper()
	pool := teacherDecisionIntegrationPool(t)
	fixture := &teacherDecisionIntegrationFixture{
		pool:      pool,
		teacherID: uuid.NewString(),
		studentID: uuid.NewString(),
	}
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	_, err := pool.Exec(context.Background(), `
INSERT INTO personal_teacher (
    id,student_id,teacher_profile_id,language,communication_style,pedagogy_profile,
    hint_policy,intervention_mode,version,created_at,updated_at
) VALUES ($1,$2,'integration-profile','ru','integration','integration',
    'scaffold','manual',1,$3,$3)
`, fixture.teacherID, fixture.studentID, now)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		ctx := context.Background()
		_, _ = pool.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE teacher_dialog_job SET status='blocked',claim_token=NULL,locked_by=NULL,locked_until=NULL,response_body=NULL,delivered_message_id=NULL,teacher_response_message_id=NULL,terminal_outcome=NULL,reconciliation_state=CASE WHEN teacher_turn_schema_version=2 THEN 'unknown' ELSE NULL END,no_effect_proof_id=NULL,recoverable_outcome_id=NULL,error_code='integration_cleanup' WHERE personal_teacher_id=$1`, fixture.teacherID)
		_, _ = pool.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM teacher_dialog_turn_outcome WHERE teacher_job_id IN (SELECT teacher_job_id FROM teacher_dialog_job WHERE personal_teacher_id=$1)`, fixture.teacherID)
		_, _ = pool.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM teacher_dialog_turn_proof WHERE teacher_job_id IN (SELECT teacher_job_id FROM teacher_dialog_job WHERE personal_teacher_id=$1)`, fixture.teacherID)
		_, _ = pool.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM teacher_dialog_turn_cursor WHERE dialog_id IN (SELECT dialog_id FROM teacher_dialog_job WHERE personal_teacher_id=$1)`, fixture.teacherID)
		_, _ = pool.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM teacher_dialog_job WHERE personal_teacher_id=$1`, fixture.teacherID)
		_, _ = pool.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM teacher_outbox WHERE student_id=$1`, fixture.studentID)
		_, _ = pool.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM teacher_decision WHERE personal_teacher_id=$1`, fixture.teacherID)
		_, _ = pool.Exec(ctx, `DELETE FROM personal_teacher WHERE id=$1`, fixture.teacherID)
	})
	return fixture
}

func (fixture *teacherDecisionIntegrationFixture) decision(
	decisionID, eventID string,
	contextType domain.LearningContextType,
	contextID, learningActionID, correlationID string,
) (domain.TeacherDecision, domain.IntegrationEvent) {
	if correlationID == "" {
		correlationID = fixture.teacherID
	}
	if learningActionID != "" {
		correlationID = learningActionID
	}
	decision := domain.TeacherDecision{
		ID:                decisionID,
		PersonalTeacherID: fixture.teacherID,
		StudentID:         fixture.studentID,
		CorrelationID:     correlationID,
		CausationID:       eventID,
		LearningActionID:  learningActionID,
		TeachingMode:      domain.TeachingModeLesson,
		ContextType:       contextType,
		ContextID:         contextID,
		PracticeStepID:    practiceStepIDFor(contextType),
		PedagogyMethod:    "adaptive",
		PedagogyVersion:   "adaptive-v1",
		PedagogyStage:     domain.PedagogyStage("orient"),
		Strategy:          "scaffolding",
		Action:            domain.TeacherActionRespond,
		ReasonCode:        "integration",
		ReasonSummary:     "integration decision",
		PolicyVersion:     "teacher-policy.v1",
		CreatedAt:         time.Now().UTC(),
	}
	event, err := domain.NewIntegrationEvent(
		eventID, domain.SubjectTeacherDecisionRecorded, decision.CorrelationID,
		decision.CausationID, decision.StudentID, decision.CreatedAt,
		domain.TeacherDecisionRecordedSchemaVersion, decision,
	)
	if err != nil {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("build integration event: %v", err))
	}
	return decision, event
}

func practiceStepIDFor(contextType domain.LearningContextType) string {
	if contextType == domain.LearningContextPracticeTask || contextType == domain.LearningContextProject {
		return "implement"
	}
	return ""
}

func TestTeacherDecisionRepositoryStoresNullableAndUUIDLearningActionIDs(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	fixture := newTeacherDecisionIntegrationFixture(t)
	repository := TeacherDecisionRepository{Pool: fixture.pool}

	t.Run("empty learning action is stored as null", func(t *testing.T) {
		decisionID, eventID := uuid.NewString(), uuid.NewString()
		decision, event := fixture.decision(decisionID, eventID, domain.LearningContextGeneral, "", "", "")
		require.NoError(t, repository.Record(context.Background(), decision, event))

		var stored string
		var isNull bool
		require.NoError(t, fixture.pool.QueryRow(context.Background(), `
SELECT COALESCE(learning_action_id::text,''), learning_action_id IS NULL
FROM teacher_decision WHERE id=$1
`, decisionID).Scan(&stored, &isNull))
		require.Empty(t, stored)
		require.True(t, isNull)
	})

	t.Run("valid learning action is stored as uuid", func(t *testing.T) {
		decisionID, eventID, learningActionID := uuid.NewString(), uuid.NewString(), uuid.NewString()
		decision, event := fixture.decision(decisionID, eventID, domain.LearningContextPracticeTask, uuid.NewString(), learningActionID, "")
		require.NoError(t, repository.Record(context.Background(), decision, event))

		var stored string
		require.NoError(t, fixture.pool.QueryRow(context.Background(), `
SELECT learning_action_id::text FROM teacher_decision WHERE id=$1
`, decisionID).Scan(&stored))
		require.Equal(t, learningActionID, stored)
		var stepID string
		require.NoError(t, fixture.pool.QueryRow(context.Background(), `
SELECT practice_step_id FROM teacher_decision WHERE id=$1
`, decisionID).Scan(&stepID))
		require.Equal(t, "implement", stepID)
		decisions, err := repository.ListByLearningAction(context.Background(), fixture.studentID, learningActionID)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.Len(t, decisions, 1)
		require.Equal(t, "implement", decisions[0].PracticeStepID)
	})

	t.Run("invalid learning action rolls back decision and outbox", func(t *testing.T) {
		decisionID, eventID := uuid.NewString(), uuid.NewString()
		decision, event := fixture.decision(decisionID, eventID, domain.LearningContextPracticeTask, uuid.NewString(), "not-a-uuid", "")
		err := repository.Record(context.Background(), decision, event)
		require.Error(t, err)
		require.ErrorContains(t, err, "invalid input syntax for type uuid")

		var decisionCount, outboxCount int
		require.NoError(t, fixture.pool.QueryRow(context.Background(), `SELECT count(*) FROM teacher_decision WHERE id=$1`, decisionID).Scan(&decisionCount))
		require.NoError(t, fixture.pool.QueryRow(context.Background(), `SELECT count(*) FROM teacher_outbox WHERE event_id=$1`, eventID).Scan(&outboxCount))
		require.Zero(t, decisionCount)
		require.Zero(t, outboxCount)
	})
}

func TestTeacherDialogSaveGeneratedCommitsDecisionAndOutboxAtomically(t *testing.T) {
	fixture := newTeacherDecisionIntegrationFixture(t)
	repository := TeacherDialogJobRepository{Pool: fixture.pool}
	ctx := context.Background()
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	eventID, dialogID, sourceMessageID, claimToken := uuid.NewString(), uuid.NewString(), uuid.NewString(), uuid.NewString()
	_, err := fixture.pool.Exec(ctx, `
INSERT INTO teacher_dialog_job (
    event_id,teacher_job_id,dialog_id,event_sequence,source_message_id,source_message_sequence,student_id,
    personal_teacher_id,context_type,occurred_at,status,claim_token,locked_by,locked_until,
    attempts,next_attempt_at,accepted_at,updated_at
) VALUES ($1,$1,$2,1,$3,1,$4,$5,'general',$6,'processing',$7,'integration-worker',$8,1,$6,$6,$6)
`, eventID, dialogID, sourceMessageID, fixture.studentID, fixture.teacherID, now, claimToken, now.Add(time.Minute))
	require.NoError(t, err)

	decision, event := fixture.decision(uuid.NewString(), eventID, domain.LearningContextGeneral, "", "", dialogID)
	require.NoError(t, repository.SaveGenerated(ctx, eventID, claimToken, decision, event, "cached response", uuid.NewString(), now))

	var status, responseBody string
	var storedDecisionID string
	require.NoError(t, fixture.pool.QueryRow(ctx, `
SELECT status,response_body,decision_id::text FROM teacher_dialog_job WHERE event_id=$1
`, eventID).Scan(&status, &responseBody, &storedDecisionID))
	require.Equal(t, "processing", status)
	require.Equal(t, "cached response", responseBody)
	require.Equal(t, decision.ID, storedDecisionID)

	var decisionCount, outboxCount int
	require.NoError(t, fixture.pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT count(*) FROM teacher_decision WHERE id=$1`, decision.ID).Scan(&decisionCount))
	require.NoError(t, fixture.pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT count(*) FROM teacher_outbox WHERE event_id=$1`, event.EventID).Scan(&outboxCount))
	require.Equal(t, 1, decisionCount)
	require.Equal(t, 1, outboxCount)
}

func TestTeacherDialogSaveGeneratedRollsBackDecisionAndOutboxTogether(t *testing.T) {
	fixture := newTeacherDecisionIntegrationFixture(t)
	repository := TeacherDialogJobRepository{Pool: fixture.pool}
	ctx := context.Background()
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	eventID, dialogID, sourceMessageID, claimToken := uuid.NewString(), uuid.NewString(), uuid.NewString(), uuid.NewString()
	_, err := fixture.pool.Exec(ctx, `
INSERT INTO teacher_dialog_job (
    event_id,teacher_job_id,dialog_id,event_sequence,source_message_id,source_message_sequence,student_id,
    personal_teacher_id,context_type,occurred_at,status,claim_token,locked_by,locked_until,
    attempts,next_attempt_at,accepted_at,updated_at
) VALUES ($1,$1,$2,1,$3,1,$4,$5,'general',$6,'processing',$7,'integration-worker',$8,1,$6,$6,$6)
`, eventID, dialogID, sourceMessageID, fixture.studentID, fixture.teacherID, now, claimToken, now.Add(time.Minute))
	require.NoError(t, err)

	decision, event := fixture.decision(uuid.NewString(), eventID, domain.LearningContextGeneral, "", "", dialogID)
	decision.Strategy = ""
	err = repository.SaveGenerated(ctx, eventID, claimToken, decision, event, "cached response", uuid.NewString(), now)
	require.Error(t, err)

	var decisionCount, outboxCount int
	require.NoError(t, fixture.pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT count(*) FROM teacher_decision WHERE id=$1`, decision.ID).Scan(&decisionCount))
	require.NoError(t, fixture.pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT count(*) FROM teacher_outbox WHERE event_id=$1`, event.EventID).Scan(&outboxCount))
	require.Zero(t, decisionCount)
	require.Zero(t, outboxCount)

	var status string
	var responseBody *string
	var storedDecisionID *string
	require.NoError(t, fixture.pool.QueryRow(ctx, `
SELECT status,response_body,decision_id::text FROM teacher_dialog_job WHERE event_id=$1
`, eventID).Scan(&status, &responseBody, &storedDecisionID))
	require.Equal(t, "processing", status)
	require.Nil(t, responseBody)
	require.Nil(t, storedDecisionID)
}
